description: Mikael Brandt, experienced programmer. Peace of mind for products built with AI, and lower AI costs for businesses that run their workflows on agents.

a_want: You want to feel confident your foundations will hold as you grow.

a_get_title: Peace of mind as you grow.
a_get_body: I dig deep into your code, architecture and operations and make sure what the agents built holds up, not just for the next demo but for your real-world requirements over time. Your team keeps shipping with agents, on foundations you can trust.
